FN-CH71QQQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 121
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Kerry (Bubba)
Commissions Underwood
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 121 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama State Board for
Registered Interior Designers until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The
provisions of this bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
